description: One level beyond the bound: t.a nests 65 masks. Cx::masked asserts the depth below MAX_MASK_DEPTH (64) on entry (cx.rs:3323), so the 65th panics before any step of the section runs: the task ends Panicked with the assertion's message, its step has no observation, and the sibling t.b is untouched. A refusal the C kernel gives as ASX_E_INVALID_STATE from asx_task_mask.
